changelog:
幻念收件与通道可靠性升级（1.6.5）

幻念收件：常驻引擎通知到达即转发，锁屏持续接收；心跳跟随收货循环，网关异常 5→15→30→60 秒退避、5xx 降级短轮询；错误码翻成人话，配对接受 202。
通道与送达：失败重放队列与通道分诊，状态页显示最近一次失败；一键全链路自检；送达格补 httpCode/尝试次数/耗时；Webhook 支持自定义请求头与请求方法。
规则引擎：设备状态条件（电量/网络）进词表，模板新增 %battery% / %network%。
稳定性：修复启动屏卡死、停止监听后通知残留、部分机型偏好设置读取失败；数据库打不开不再一律按损坏处理；首页历史入口改名「历史记录」。
changelogEn:
Smarter receiving and channel reliability (1.6.5)

Fnthink receiving: the receiver is now a resident engine that forwards on arrival and keeps receiving while locked; heartbeats follow the receive loop; gateway trouble backs off 5→15→30→60 s and 5xx falls back to short polling; error codes are translated and pairing accepts 202.
Channels and delivery: failed-delivery replay queue with per-channel triage, last-failure readout on the status page, one-tap end-to-end self-check, delivery cells record httpCode/attempts/elapsed; webhooks accept custom headers and HTTP methods.
Rule engine: device-state conditions (battery/network) join the vocabulary and templates add %battery% / %network%.
Stability: fixed the splash-screen hang, the leftover listening notification after stopping, and preference-read failures on some devices; a database that fails to open is no longer treated as corrupt; the home history entry is now "History".
